svg.text: Sheet 2 · Jumper list: tick each row as you fit it

Hole names: B1/B2 = board, letter + number = column + row (as printed on the board). Rails are named by what they carry; @n = the rail hole next to row n. Length = routed length on sheet 1 (cut ~10 mm longer for bends).
3V3 from Pico pin 36 to B1 top 3V3 rail
GND from Pico pin 33 to B1 top GND rail
GND from Pico pin 8 to B1 bottom GND rail
3V3 rail link, B1 top to B1 bottom
VBUS (Pico pin 40) to B2 bottom 5V rail
GND rail link, B1 bottom to B2 top
3V3 rail link, B1 bottom to B2 top
GND rail link, B2 top to B2 bottom
GP19 SPI0 MOSI to TFT SI
GP18 SPI0 SCK to TFT CK
GP6 I2C1 SDA to OLED Data
GP7 I2C1 SCL to OLED Clk
OLED DC (= SA0) to GND, sets address 0x3C
GP1 UART0 RX from opto output
COIL- : Q1 collector to D1 anode
COIL- : D1 anode to RL1 pin 16
COIL- : RL1 pin 16 to RL2 pin 1
COIL- : RL2 pin 1 to D2 anode
BYPASS 4: RL1 NC1 (pin 6) to RL2 NC1 (pin 6)
BYPASS 5: RL1 NC2 (pin 11) to RL2 NC2 (pin 11)
MIDI IN DIN pin 4 to RL1 COM1 (pin 4)
MIDI IN DIN pin 5 to RL1 COM2 (pin 13)
OUT A DIN pin 4 to RL2 COM1 (pin 4)
OUT A DIN pin 5 to RL2 COM2 (pin 13)
OUT A DIN pin 2 (shield) to GND
OUT B DIN pin 4 to R8 33R
OUT B DIN pin 5 to R9 10R
OUT B DIN pin 2 (shield) to GND
B1 straddles c/h, rows 6-25, USB end off the left edge.
pin 1 GP0 = h6 ... pin 20 GP15 = h25;
pin 21 GP16 = c25 ... pin 40 VBUS = c6.
B2 E e9, B e10, C e11
B1 header in column a: Data a55, Clk a56, DC a57, Rst a58, CS a59, 3v3 a60
B1 header in column a: V+ a36, 3V a37, G a38, CK a39, SI a40, SO a41
TC a42, RT a43, DC a44, CC a45, BL a46
Resistors and capacitors: either way round. Diodes: A = anode, K = cathode (band).
Relays: Omron G5V-2 terminal numbers (sheet 3). Q1: E, B, C.
